name: heytea-doodle-poster
title_zh: 把照片变成喜茶风涂鸦海报或桌宠
tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，得到歪扭儿童字+实物小人的喜茶风海报；或让食物变成会动的桌宠。适合做头像、壁纸、送人。
tagline_en: Turn one photo into a HEYTEA-style doodle poster with wobbly kid-font, or a living desktop pet from your.
desc_en: Turn an uploaded photo into either a HEYTEA-inspired object-and-doodle poster or a personalized hand-drawn desktop pet with approved character concepts, schema-v2 source-faithful actions or schema-v3 flavor-monster behaviors, optional physical interactions, and an importable pet pack. Use for 喜茶简笔画海报, 歪扭儿童字, 实物加小人涂鸦, 桌宠, 照片变桌面宠物, 食物桌宠, or 饮料桌宠.
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳：它按 schema-v2 忠实还原原图动作，或按 schema-v3 放飞成怪物性格。
why_en: Not a filter: schema-v2 stays faithful to your photo's pose, schema-v3 lets it mutate into a monster—both ship with an.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不接多图合成；海报限定喜茶简笔画+歪扭字风格，桌宠需先通过角色概念审批；物理交互仅限预设动作。
limit_en: Single photo only, no multi-image compositing. Poster style locked to HEYTEA doodle + wobbly font. Pet needs character-concept approval first.
